watch: Key highlights from the management commentary  Margin expansion should continue driven by the operating leverage, although better-than-planned profitability is likely to be reinvested in brand marketing, Bharat market development and international expansion.

Incremental volumes should improve factory utilization and drive manufacturing efficiencies across the portfolio.  Manufacturing integration remains the key margin lever, with in-sourcing gains (frames +72% YoY, lenses +52% YoY) largely offset by ~20-25% INR depreciation against the RMB.
